 "data": "%% Presentation-friendly idempotency overview for Video 2, Slide 7.
%% Detailed concurrency/unique-constraint behavior remains in idempotency-generic.mmd.
flowchart LR
 A[Request<br/>Idempotency-Key: K] --> B{Redis lookup}

 B -->|Hit| C{Same payload?}
 C -->|Yes| D[Replay previous result<br/>No new side effect]
 C -->|No| E[409 Conflict<br/>Idempotency key reused]

 B -->|Miss| F{Database fallback}
 F -->|Existing + same payload| D
 F -->|Existing + different payload| E
 F -->|No existing request| G[Process normally]

 G --> H[Persist result]
 H --> I[Cache response in Redis]
 I --> J[Return result]

 classDef entry fill:#E8F0FE,stroke:#3B6EA8,stroke-width:2px,color:#172B4D;
 classDef decision fill:#FFF4CC,stroke:#B58B00,stroke-width:2px,color:#3D3200;
 classDef success fill:#E6F4EA,stroke:#2E7D32,stroke-width:2px,color:#173A1A;
 classDef conflict fill:#FDECEC,stroke:#C62828,stroke-width:2px,color:#5A1717;
 classDef process fill:#F3F4F6,stroke:#6B7280,stroke-width:2px,color:#1F2937;

 class A entry;
 class B,C,F decision;
 class D,J success;
 class E conflict;
 class G,H,I process;
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
